title: Flow
description: The work as a program of boxes (design 0013): each a big task with a deliverable, done by a model in a session of its own, or a decision you make; the lines say what comes next.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The kind and version this file is written in; always its first field.

title.description: The name clients show for this record; the file's own name when empty.
title.title: Title

workspace.description: The workspace whose folder its boxes work in; the folder it is kept in names it, and this, when given, must be the same.
workspace.title: Workspace

auto_accept.description: Boxes the model proposes join the flow at once, when they pass the checks, up to the cap; off: each waits for you.
auto_accept.title: Auto-accept

auto_accept_cap.description: How many proposals auto-accept may accept in one run.
auto_accept_cap.title: Auto-accept cap

wait_after_every_box.description: Every box waits for you when it is done, to step through.
wait_after_every_box.title: Wait after every box

next_flow.description: Once its last gate is approved, the next flow is made from its INTEGRATE's brief: ask, you are asked whether to run it now; run, it starts at once; off, none is made.
next_flow.title: Next flow

follows.description: The flow it was made after, from that flow's INTEGRATE's brief.
follows.title: Follows

next.description: The flow made after it, from its INTEGRATE's brief: <workspace>/<name>.
next.title: Next

orchestrator.description: A model that steers the run at checkpoints while it is on (design 0013 §16).

built.description: Set when the model drafted it in a planning session and Clank wrote it: that session, when, and the brief written with the model.
built.title: Built

boxes.description: Its boxes; DECOMPOSE's tasks run in this order.
boxes.title: Boxes

Box.description: A step of a flow: a big task with a deliverable, done by a model in a session of its own, or the owner's.

id.description: Its name in the flow's lines: letters, digits, '-' and '_'.
id.title: Id

type.description: you: your brief or work; plan: a plan (PLAN.md); verify: a verdict on an earlier box's deliverable; decompose: proposed tasks; task: its deliverable; integrate: a summary of every deliverable and the next flow's brief; gate: your decision.
type.title: Type

title.description: What it does, in a few words.
title.title: Title

checks.description: A VERIFY only: the earlier box whose deliverable it checks.
checks.title: Checks

model.description: The preset it runs on, by its id or title, loaded before it starts; empty: the flow's (a VERIFY's: the preset of the box it checks).
model.title: Model

mode.description: plan, review or auto, for its own session; empty: plan for PLAN, VERIFY, DECOMPOSE and INTEGRATE, the workspace's for a TASK.
mode.title: Mode

sees.description: The files of the folder its first message hands it; it may still read any other.
sees.title: Sees

shows.description: A GATE's: the files it shows you, to approve or edit.
shows.title: Shows

prompt.description: Its own words: yours, or drafted by a DECOMPOSE.
prompt.title: Prompt

writes.description: The files it must write in the folder; it is done when each was written during its try.
writes.title: Deliverable

holds.description: What its deliverable's files hold, in words.
holds.title: What they hold

accept_when.description: What makes its deliverable right, one thing per line, checked by a VERIFY or by you at a gate.
accept_when.title: Accept when

accept_command.description: A command run in the workspace's container after it, which passes when it exits 0; empty: none.
accept_command.title: Accept command

when_done.description: go on: the box after it starts; wait: the flow waits for you first.
when_done.title: When done

tries.description: How many times it may run before a gate decides; empty: the flow's.
tries.title: Tries

limits.description: What one try may use; empty values: the flow's.

mcp_servers.description: The workspace's MCP servers it gets; empty: those the workspace's agent gets.
mcp_servers.title: MCP servers

proposed.description: Where it came from, when it was accepted from a proposal.
proposed.title: Proposed

Box.title: Box

Built.description:
How a flow built with the model came to be (design 0013 §15, decision 0097): the planning session its draft came
from, when Clank wrote it, and the brief the owner wrote with the model, which its first box takes (decision
0098).

session.description: The planning session the draft came from; empty when not known yet.
session.title: Session

at.description: When Clank wrote the flow from the model's last draft.
at.title: Written

brief.description: The brief written with the model: its first box is done by it when it is there.
brief.title: Brief

before.description: The brief's fingerprint when the planning began (empty: not there): a brief still so is not the one written with the model, and its first box asks for it.
before.title: Brief before

Built.title: Built

CheckpointLimits.description: What one checkpoint of the orchestrator may use.

minutes.description: How long one checkpoint may run.
minutes.title: Minutes

tokens.description: How many tokens one checkpoint may write, its thinking included.
tokens.title: Tokens written

CheckpointLimits.title: CheckpointLimits

FlowDefaults.description: What every box takes unless it names its own.

model.description: The preset each box runs on, by its id or title ("daily 262K"); empty: whatever the main slot runs when the box starts.
model.title: Model

tries.description: How many times a box may run before a gate decides (a VERIFY's loop).
tries.title: Tries

limits.description: What one try of a box may use.
limits.title: Limits

whole_up_to.description: The bytes of a text file a box's first message hands whole; a larger one is named by its path and size, for the box to read with its tools.
whole_up_to.title: Handed whole up to

note_up_to.description: The characters of each earlier box's handoff note a box's first message hands; a longer note is cut there, saying where the whole is.
note_up_to.title: Notes handed up to

copied_up_to.description: The bytes of a deliverable copied into the run's folder when its box ends; a larger one is kept by its fingerprint only.
copied_up_to.title: Copied up to

FlowDefaults.title: FlowDefaults

FlowLimits.description: What one try of a box may use, unless the box says otherwise.

minutes.description: How long one try of a box may run.
minutes.title: Minutes

tokens.description: How many tokens the model may write in one try, its thinking included (a prompt read again from the engine's cache is not counted).
tokens.title: Tokens written

FlowLimits.title: FlowLimits

Follows.description:
Where a next flow came from (design 0013 §3, decision 0091): the flow whose last gate was approved, its run, the
INTEGRATE that wrote its brief, and the brief's file.

run.description: That flow's run whose last gate was approved.
run.title: Run

by.description: The INTEGRATE that wrote its brief.
by.title: By

brief.description: The brief's file, copied into its own first box's file when it first runs.
brief.title: Brief

replaces.description: The fingerprint of its first box's file when it was made (empty: not in the folder): the brief is copied over it only while it is unchanged.
replaces.title: Replaces

Follows.title: Follows

Limits.description: What one try of this box may use; each empty takes the flow's.

minutes.description: How long one try may run; empty: the flow's.
minutes.title: Minutes

tokens.description: How many tokens the model may write in one try, its thinking included; empty: the flow's.
tokens.title: Tokens written

Limits.title: Limits

Line.description: What comes after a box: a then line, or a VERIFY's pass or fail line.

when.description: A VERIFY's lines only: pass, to the box after it; fail, back to the box it checks, with the findings.
when.title: When

Line.title: Line

Orchestrator.description:
The model that steers a run at checkpoints while it is on (design 0013 §16, decisions 0123-0124): after each box
a model ran, and at each question the run would ask you.

on.description: Steer the run: a checkpoint after each box, and at each question; it decides as you would, within its limits, and you may answer first.
on.title: On

model.description: The preset its checkpoints run on, by its id or title; empty: the flow's.
model.title: Model

role.description: steer: it decides the run's questions and may change the boxes ahead; watch: it checks each box is on track, goes on or pauses the run, and leaves every question to you. In both it tells you at once what you should know.
role.title: Role

final_review.description: Who decides the last gate: orchestrator, or owner (it waits for you).
final_review.title: Final review

changes.description: How many changes it may make in one run: each box changed or added, send back, skip and extra try.
changes.title: Changes

extra_tries.description: How many tries past its cap it may give a box.
extra_tries.title: Extra tries

stall.description: Checkpoints in a row without progress after which it may not go on: it changes the plan or stops.
stall.title: Stall

Orchestrator.title: Orchestrator

Proposed.description: Where a box accepted from a proposal came from (design 0013 §9).

run.description: The run in which it was proposed.
run.title: Run

by.description: The box that proposed it, a DECOMPOSE above all.
by.title: Proposed by

accepted.description: owner: you accepted it; auto-accept: the flow's setting did, within its cap.
accepted.title: Accepted by

Proposed.title: Proposed
